format:
  revealjs:
    theme: default
    slide-number: true
    embed-resources: true
    css: css/slides.css
---

## Introduction

- Teaser (image/video)
- Title
- Authors (orator presenting in bold)
- Affiliations
- Fundings

## Motivation

[Context]{.slide-subtitle}

- What is the context?

## Motivation

[Problem]{.slide-subtitle}

- What is the problem?
- Why is it important?

## Background

[Previous work]{.slide-subtitle}

- What are the previous works related to this problem? (at least 3 references)

## Background

[Research Gap]{.slide-subtitle}

- What is the gap that previous work fail to close? (a comparison table is recommended)


## Proposal

[Concept]{.slide-subtitle}

- What idea do you propose to close the gap? (visuals are recommended)

## Implementation

[Hardware & Software]{.slide-subtitle}

- How did you implement your idea? (hardware, software, algorithms, diagrams, CAD drawings, etc.)

## Technical Evaluation

[Design]{.slide-subtitle}


- What is the research question?
- What are the hypotheses?
- How did you design your technical evaluation? (factors, variables, apparatus, procedure)

## Technical Evaluation

[Results and Discussion]{.slide-subtitle}

- What are the results of your user study? (descriptive statistics, inferential statistics, figures, tables)
- What are the implications of your results? (limitations, threats to validity, lessons learned)


## User Study

[Design]{.slide-subtitle}

- What is the research question?
- What are the hypotheses?
- How did you design your user study? (factors, tasks, variables, participants, apparatus, procedure)

## User Study

[Results and Discussion]{.slide-subtitle}

- What are the results of your user study? (descriptive statistics, inferential statistics, figures, tables)
- What are the implications of your results? (limitations, threats to validity, lessons learned)


## Limitations and Future Work

- What are the limitations of your work?
- What are the future directions of your work?

## Conclusion

- What are the main contributions of your work?
- Thank the audience for their attention and ask for questions.
